text:
alex: Heads-up — a customer reported a short window during their BYOK rotation where a newly created service principal was able to call Decrypt on the tenant. Tagging sec + oncall. I have the initial log snippets.
maria: looking now — telemetry shows a sharp spike in KMS Decrypt calls from svc/keystore-proxy-new at ~03:22Z.
jit: I rolled the keystore-proxy RBAC tweak last night (03:20Z). rollout was phased but looks like the binding propagated to one region early.
chris: sec-bot timeline: new role-binding created 2025-03-01T03:20:47Z, first successful Decrypt 03:21:15Z, last suspicious call 03:22:58Z. window ~1m43s :warning:
oncall-sre: Can we confirm which principal invoked and whether it read ciphertext or only metadata?
maria: log line: "principal=svc/keystore-proxy-new action=Decrypt target=acct-777/cmk-09f3 result=OK req_id=rz-9f3a2"
jit: the intent was alpha-scoped binding (namespace=infra-alpha) — idiot move, I used namespace=tenant-wide in the manifest. Reverting now.
alex: Please snapshot forensic logs before you revert anything. We need immutable evidence for compliance and the customer's audit team.
sec-bot: Executing snapshot request. Use: ```/hsm snapshot --start 2025-03-01T03:20:00Z --end 2025-03-01T03:25:00Z --dst s3://forensics/redwood/acct-777/ --mode=immutable``` :white_check_mark:
maria: also saw Vault issued a short-lived role token around 03:21Z: token_id=rb-901 ttl=600s. That matches the Decrypt calls.
oncall-sre: Quick mitigation checklist — revoke rb-901, revoke any active sessions for svc/keystore-proxy-new, roll proxy credentials, and patch the RBAC manifest to namespace-scoped binding.
jit: opened PR #5408 to revert and add unit/integration tests for tenant-scoping. Will also add a terraform guard to prevent clusterrolebinding with tenant:* labels.
chris: Important: audit logging gap — the proxy hop between load-balancer and sidecar dropped X-Request-Id on ~40% of requests, so correlating user->HSM will need correlation by timestamp and token. Maria, can you produce a mapping script?
maria: on it. quick script to join logs by token header:
```
# join by x-vault-token
jq -r '.req_id + "\\t" + .vault_token' lb_logs.json | sort > lb.map
jq -r '.req_id + "\\t" + .req_id' proxy_logs.json | sort > proxy.map
join -t$'\\t' lb.map proxy.map > correlation.tsv
```
maria: will push the mapping to the forensic bucket once snapshot completes.
alex: Incident classification — per policy, cross-tenant key access, even short-lived, = P2. Notify customer security and compliance within 3 hours. Initiate triage and postmortem.
chris: Also file for a vulnerability triage: root cause is RBAC misconfiguration + insufficient guardrails on manifests. Severity candidate: High for process vuln (human error leading to potential data access).
sec-bot: Evidence retention: snapshot stored at s3://forensics/redwood/acct-777/snap-20250301T0322.log (sha256: a3f9...) — retained 90d per incident policy :lock:
oncall-sre: Are there any legal/regulatory flags? This is EU customer — we need DPO loop if data residency or breach classification involved.
alex: Yup, looped legal and DPO. Maria, can you draft the customer notice language (high level, no details) and send to compliance for review?
maria: Yes. Draft ETA 60m. Will include steps we took, timeline, and mitigation. No plaintext keys were exported per HSM attestations in the snapshot.
jit: I'll coordinate the rollback, tests, and the terraform guard. ETA for rollback + test deploy: 20m. Will notify when in canary.
chris: Post-incident actions: 1) enforce CI blocker for ClusterRoleBinding containing tenant wildcards, 2) add automated RBAC diff alerting to eng-sre, 3) increase correlation headers across proxy chain, 4) tabletop with infra+security every quarter.
alex: Good. Assigning owners: rollback=jit, logs+mapping=maria, snapshot/forensics=sec-bot, customer comms=maria+legal, postmortem=alex+chris. We'll reconvene in #incident-status in 30m. :thumbsup:
sec-bot: Incident ticket created: INC-20250301-0892. Severity P2. Linked artifacts: s3://forensics/redwood/acct-777/, PR #5408. :spiral_notepad:
chris: Thanks team. Keep updates short in this thread. If anything else shows up (exfil attempts, multiple customers affected) escalate to P1.
alex: noted. Closing initial thread, will paste customer-facing timeline when ready.
